title: SWE-Tester: Training Open-Source LLMs for Issue Reproduction in Real-World Repositories
abstract: arXiv:2601.13713v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Software testing is crucial for ensuring the correctness and reliability of software systems. Automated generation of issue reproduction tests from natural language issue descriptions enhances developer productivity by simplifying root cause analysis, promotes test-driven development -- "test first, write code later", and can be used for improving the effectiveness of automated issue resolution systems like coding agents. Existing methods proposed for this task predominantly rely on closed-source LLMs, with limited exploration of open models. To address this, we propose SWE-Tester -- a novel pipeline for training open-source LLMs to generate issue reproduction tests. First, we curate a high-quality training dataset of 41K instances from 2.6K open-source GitHub repositories and use it to train LLMs of varying sizes and families. The fine-tuned models achieve absolute improvements of up to 10\% in success rate and 21\% in change

translated_title: SWE-Tester：训练开源大语言模型在真实世界代码仓库中进行问题复现
translated_abstract: 软件测试对于确保软件系统的正确性和可靠性至关重要。从自然语言问题描述中自动生成问题复现测试，能够通过简化根本原因分析来提高开发人员的工作效率，促进测试驱动开发——“先写测试，后写代码”，并可用于提升编码智能体等自动化问题解决系统的有效性。针对该任务提出的现有方法主要依赖于闭源大语言模型，对开源模型的探索十分有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 SWE-Tester——一个用于训练开源大语言模型生成问题复现测试的新型流程。首先，我们从2600个开源GitHub仓库中精心构建了一个包含4.1万个实例的高质量训练数据集，并用它训练了不同规模和不同系列的大语言模型。微调后的模型在成功率和变更方面分别实现了高达10%和21%的绝对提升。
tldr: 提出 SWE-Tester 流程，通过从2600个开源仓库构建的4.1万实例高质量数据集微调开源大语言模型，使其能够自动生成问题复现测试，成功率最高提升10%。
en_tdlr: SWE-Tester is a novel pipeline that fine-tunes open-source LLMs on a curated 41K-instance dataset from 2.6K GitHub repositories to generate issue reproduction tests, achieving up to 10% absolute improvement in success rate.
